measurement.runtime: fresh child process wall and worker apply seconds
measurement.input: same deterministic float32 analytic field for both algorithms
measurement.repeat: exact source and output SHA-256 within each algorithm/shape
measurement.quality_identity: already frozen by P3H; this leaf must not weaken it

forbidden_fallbacks: change kernels, profile, field or shapes
exclude a slow or high-memory run
compare warm direct against cached FFT or reuse a process
change thread settings after viewing results

branch_rule.pass: retain FFT as the isolated large-radius CPU performance baseline; native implementation and combined-chain eligibility remain separate
branch_rule.fail: close FFT as a Standard performance candidate and preserve P3E direct plus P3H functional evidence

claim_ceiling: local Windows/Python fresh-process performance evidence for an isolated generic backing-return compiler; no combined-chain, native, mobile, GPU, stock, calibration or product claim
